reviews.text: Chris, Dylan and Mike were like a dream team. These guys were nothing short of amazing. I have an autistic son who asks alot of questions and they were so gentle and sweet with him in answering all his question. Benjamin Franklin will forever have my business. 10/10 recommend! Thank you Benjamin Franklin for the great first time customer experience.

The Benjamin Franklin team did a great job. Very clear communication and options for the solution to my hot water slab leak. Competitive pricing. Incredible customer service. Quick and efficient work. Even after the work was complete, I had a concern and was able to connect immediately with Nick (even on a Friday night!). A team member stopped by on the way to another job to confirm that the job was complete!

I use Benjamin Franklin today for the first time and they were excellent. It was very easy to make an appointment. The technician was on time and he did a great job and I got to use their end of the year discount so it was a free visit and I got money off my service. He also was kind enough to give me the name of a contractor for future work.

Alie Joseph did a great job repairing our outdoor hose bib today. He was friendly and competent. We got a 2 year warranty on parts and labor and the price was reasonable. He came out the same day we called, which was great.

Gio Garcia was very professional and courteous. Arrive promptly and was able to diagnose and fix the issue with our hot water heater. He explained everything and also made me aware of some potential future issues and how to correct those if we choose to do upgrades at a later time. We recently had other work done be Benjamin Franklin plumbing and although it was a different technician, we got the same great service we’ve come to expect! Thanks Gio and the rest of the folks a Benjamin Franklin!

Just had the hands down best experience with Jason W. At Benjamin Franklin plumbing. He was very knowledgeable and explained to us what the issue was and the best solution to fix it. He is a kind man that cares about his customers. Highly recommend him and the company. It was very easy to book a timely appointment and the follow up was great.

PS: Had to have BF come out again for follow up on my issue. Curtis P and Chris were the plumbers who helped me this time around and I can't say enough go

We have been very pleased with the plumbing repair/replacement. I was informed throughout the process with times and what was going to be done at each stage. John, Tyler and Nick were very professional and wonderful answering very question and concern. I would use them again and recommend them to others.

Chris, from Ben Franklin plumbing,  is as good as it gets! The whole team behind Chris, who is a great leader and professional to train them up as well. I have used this company for my new gas fireplace, 2 new hot water heaters, and now a bathroom (leak) and subsequent re-model. They really do go above and beyond and the one thing I love most is, you never hear “I don’t know” from these guys. There is no job they can’t do! Athens Clinkscale was amazing! Very quick efficient with his work! Very friendly, very kind and very helping highly recommend. Above and beyond on his work!

Athens C. and his partner did a great job quickly and professionally.  Both were friendly and listened to my concerns.  We have been customers with Benjamin Franklin for years and highly recommend them.

Quick, on-time, and knowledgeable about anything they're looking at.  The techs were outstanding.  The issue was identified and fixed quicker than expected.  The only downside is that the company charges quite a bit, but at least the work is warrantied.

Thank you so much for sending a technician like Athens Clinkscale. He was very professional,  explained everything to us. Helped us get financed. Put the new water heater in and was just so pleasant. I will recommend Ben Franklin and Athens to any one who has any plumbing needs. You guys Rock!!!

Alie was great!  Came that day for an emergency we had, explained the problem, gave quote and fixed it quickly.  Communication was excellent and the online approval for estimate and payment was super easy.  Very satisfied.

Randy did at great job servicing my home on today. My outside faucet had a leak and needed to be replaced. Jason was a pleasure to work with today! He was extremely thoughtful and thorough in his communication with us and patient as we were working through things with our home warranty company. Thank you, Jason!

Athens was at my home within an hour of my call to Benjamin Franklin. He walked me through every step of diagnosing the issue and made sure I understand everything before taking any action. He was a true professional every step of the way!

My plumber was Curtis Price, and he  educated me on the importance of keeping my plumbing in good work order. He gave me tips on how to keep the drains clear and by running the water in the bathroom that is mostly unused. I didn't know how important this was.

Keean, John and Jacob are amazing and very helpful and informative during the process of our visits. John and Jacob went out of their days and times to make sure we were fully taken care of.
Nick Fontenot is the best. Kind, easy going and so knowledgeable. We had a storage from the kitchen to the street. He made quick work of the repair.

I highly recommend Gio at Ben Franklin Plumbing. He’s very nice, professional, good at explaining things, and overall I had a great experience with him and Zach.

They were able to repair our drain at less than half the quoted price of some other plumbers simply by isolating and replacing the location of the fault, rather than recommending the nuclear option of just replacing the entire house’s drainage system (which is under a concrete slab) due to its age.

I have used Ben Franklin before, and was so impressed with the technician, Chris Fontenot, that I didn’t even consider using another company.  He’s my guy when it comes to plumbing issues.  He’s a PRO!
Curtis was very courteous and professional! Thank you so very much! Benjamin Franklin Plumbing Company is the best!!!!
Chris was professional and kind…did an awesome job and came early as we needed help. Thanks so much for your great work and awesome customer service!!

Curtis came over very professional very friendly explained everything he was going to do explained the prices and went to work I would recommend Benjamin Franklin Plumbing this was not the first time we used them great job

I will always use Benjamin Franklin with any plumbing issues.
